items.title: Боковое меню приложения
items.description: Вертикальная навигация приложения: разделы, счётчики и текущий пункт, отмеченный полосой у края, а не только цветом текста.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-sidebar-001-*. Разметка семантическая: <nav> с подписью, внутри разделы с заголовками и списки <ul>. Активный пункт определяется сравнением подписи с activeLabel и получает aria-current="page", плотный фон и полосу через ::before. Счётчик — необязательное число справа с tabular-nums. Тема берётся из color-scheme окружения через light-dark(): подложки по умолчанию нет, компонент лежит на фоне страницы и темнеет вместе с ней, а проп background включает собственную подложку и сам подбирает ветку темы по её светлоте.

  sections={[
    { title: "Проект", items: [{ label: "Обзор", href: "/" }, { label: "Страницы", href: "/pages", count: 12 }] },
  ]}
/>

en.title: App Sidebar Nav
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-sidebar-001-* variables. The markup is semantic: a <nav> with a label, holding sections with headings and <ul> lists. The active item is determined by comparing its label with activeLabel and gets aria-current="page", a solid background and a bar through ::before. The count is an optional number on the right with tabular-nums. The theme comes from the surrounding color-scheme through light-dark(): there is no background by default, the component sits on the page background and darkens with it, while the background prop switches on a background of its own and picks the theme branch from its lightness.

en.title: Icon Rail Sidebar

en.title: Plan Card In Footer
en.description: A plan card at the bottom of the column: usage shown as a bar and a number, with the bar recolouring near the limit.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-sidebar-012-* variables. Server component. The card is pushed down with margin-top:auto, the share is computed from used and limit and rounded to a percent; at eighty percent and above the bar switches to the alarm colour. The bar carries role=progressbar with a value and a label, so usage reads without colour too.

ai.summary: A sidebar with a plan card at the bottom: usage as a bar and a number, recolouring near the limit and an upgrade button beside it.
preserve: the local --vibeui-sidebar-012-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the number next to the bar: the bar gives the estimate, the number gives precision
the recolouring near the limit: «almost out» and «plenty left» look alike otherwise
role=progressbar with a label — usage must read without colour
the card at the bottom of the column: the space under a menu is idle anyway, and that is where a meter is looked for
the calm look of the button: it is a hint, not a demand
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent surface by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: the menu items through items and the current one through activeLabel
the plan name planName, used and limit
the usage text through usageTemplate
the button caption and href
accent — the colour of the bar and the button
background — the component surface; empty means no surface, taking the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The recolour threshold is eighty percent. A different threshold is one comparison in the code.
Numbers are formatted for the Russian locale. For another locale pass ready strings through usageTemplate or adjust the toLocaleString call.
The links point at #: substitute your own or swap them for your router's Link.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
